text:
Riley: Morning all — quick exec weekly from me. High level: 1) Private GA readiness is on track but we need two final signoffs (security & docs). 2) Short-term cost target: reduce per-token infra cost by 14% vs. last quarter; we've hit ~9% so far. 3) SLA: 99.95% for Dedicated — we had one 27m degradation last week; summary below.

Riley: Action items: Morgan to lead the security signoff (ETA EOW), Alex to validate the last perf regression test, Priya to coordinate release notes and partner comms. If you have blockers DM me.

Morgan: Thanks. On signoff: security raised a question about KMS rotation timing. Need a clear rollback plan in case key rotation impacts Dedicated customers. Can infra/ops outline rollback steps?

DeployBot: deploy/infra: rollout candidate v2.13 to staging -> started by @alex. Status: 7/12 instances healthy, continuing.

Alex: Quick perf note: regression was due to a batching config change — reverted in staging. Local perf numbers: p50 latency down 6%, p95 down 11% after revert. Will run dedicated run tonight and post results tomorrow morning.

Priya: I'll draft partner notes. Also confirming internal comms: run a short ops playbook and pinned FAQ in Console docs. Who's owner for the playbook?

Riley: I'll own the playbook draft, Priya you own partner notes. Morgan, Alex — please pair on rollback and perf validation. Put owners on the ticket: #T-4782.

Morgan: Noted. I'll post a one-pager on rollback steps by EOD.

Alex: Will validate dedicated perf and upload metrics to the exec dashboard: key numbers to watch: tokens/sec, avg_kv_cache_hit_rate, and gpu_util.

Priya: Leaving a checklist in the release doc: docs, partner email, console banners, billing tier checks. Will cc legal for the data-retention blurb.

Riley: Incident summary (from last week): degraded throughput in us-west for ~27m due to a kernel scheduling bug with our batching optimizer. Root cause: edge case when sequence_length distribution changed rapidly during a heavy tail event. Mitigations: hotfix rolled, canary expanded, and we added alerts on seq_len variance. Postmortem incoming.

Riley: Risk callouts: 1) Quantization rollout for some models still needs more evals — hold rollouts on revenue-critical routes until we have 3A/3B quality checks. 2) Cost-savings experiments may increase tail latency; flag any customer-facing SLA changes.

Morgan: Agreed on quantization hold. Can we have a short dashboard for eval regressions? Even a simple failing-prompt count would help.

Alex: I'll add an eval metric to the dashboard. Starting with top-20 prompts from the regression set.

Priya: One more ask — marketing wants a short blurb for customers about Dedicated readiness next week. I'll draft and share for review.

Riley: Thanks team. Summary asks: security signoff (Morgan), perf validation (Alex), partner & customer comms (Priya), playbook/pinned ops doc (Riley). Small wins this week: cost down ~9%, p95 improved after revert. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

Morgan: :thumbsup: Will update #T-4782 when done.

DeployBot: deploy/infra: staging -> healthy 12/12. Candidate ready for canary.

Alex: Canary kickoff at 18:00 PT. Will monitor latency & errors.

Riley: Perfect. If anything spikes, tag me and @oncall. Otherwise, see you all in the weekly review.

Priya: Acknowledged, will circulate draft by noon tomorrow.

Riley: Closing the loop — thanks everyone.
